text:
Ava Chen: Heads-up — milestone mementos (3/5/10yr boxes) arrive Wed. Need volunteers to staff a pickup kiosk Thu/Fri in SF office and confirm ship lists for remote folks. Also need final headcount and shipping labels by Tue COB. @Rajan can you confirm vendor drop-off time? :tada:
Rajan Patel: Yep vendor (BoxWorks) confirmed delivery 9am Wed. I'll meet them and stash in Ops closet. I'll also bring extra packing tape. :package:
Maya Lopez: I'll take Thu morning shift 9–11. Can cover the table and handle on-site pick-ups. Sign me up. :raised_hands:
Jules: I can do Thu 11–1. Also have the laptop to check the shipping sheet. Pls share the sheet link.
Ava Chen: Sheet link: https://go/redwood/sheets/milestone-mementos — editing open. Please don't change the columns except to add notes. CSV export below for shipping team.
Ava Chen:
```
name,email,office_or_remote,address,box_type,preferred_pickup_date
Luis Gomez,luis@redwood.com,remote,123 Maple St,5yr,ship
...
```
Rajan Patel: Remote list is ~28 people. Production note: printing labels on Dymo will be slow. Might be faster to batch-print on Zebra in mailroom. @OfficeOps-Bot can you reserve Zebra Thu morning?
OfficeOps-Bot: Zebra printer reserved Thu 8:30–12:30 for people-ops. Reservation ID: ZBR-8891
Maya Lopez: For shipping, can we use the existing vendor account? Budget code 4-OPS-KUDOS? I've used it before.
Ava Chen: Yes use 4-OPS-KUDOS. Also need PO number from finance for international shipments — @Rajan can you flag with procurement?
Rajan Patel: On it. I'll DM procurement and CC finance. ETA Tue EOD.
Jules: Quick logistics Q — will we include a handwritten note card? I can bring sticky-name tags and a pen bin.
Ava Chen: Yes include a 1-line note (pre-printed) + optional handwritten. I'll attach template in the sheet. Keep messages short: "Thanks for being part of Redwood — your work matters."
Maya Lopez: Volunteer rota for Fri night? I can do 5–7 if needed.
Ava Chen: Great — Thu 9–1 covered (Maya + Jules), Fri 3–6 needs one more. @Lina, @Tom if you can jump on Fri pls. :pray:
Tom Rivera: I can take Fri 3–5. Will bring the card stack and a Sharpie.
Ava Chen: Shipping labels: export CSV by Tue and put in /ops/ship/labels. Command for printing on Zebra (batch): `zebra-print --file labels.csv --printer ZBR01 --copies 1`
Rajan Patel: Confirmed: international customs forms printed separately. Will pack customs in envelope and staple to box.
Maya Lopez: Any PMs for remote drop windows? I'll add tracking updates to the sheet as I hand off to courier.
Ava Chen: Perfect — final headcount update by Tue 5pm. If anyone finds missing addresses run `sheet.filter(status=="needs_address")` and ping me. :point_up:
KudosBot: Congratulations messages queued for milestone recipients. Sending on Thu 9am PST. :confetti_ball:
Ava Chen: Thanks team! This should be smooth. Leave small notes in the sheet if you hit snags. :sparkles:
